_original_lore: The Golden Dragon Pet can be purchased
in the Dragon's Lair within the Crystal Hollows.
The pet starts out as an egg with no stats or perks,
gaining them when it hatches at level 100.
name: 金龙头蛋 (人物)

source: The Golden Dragon Pet can be purchased
in the Dragon's Lair within the Crystal Hollows.
loreParagraphs.translation: 黄金龙宠物可在水晶洞窟内的巨龙巢穴中购买.

source: The pet starts out as an egg with no stats or perks,
gaining them when it hatches at level {{N0}}.
loreParagraphs.translation: 该宠物初始为蛋形态,没有属性或能力,在 {{N0}} 级孵化时获得它们.
